newsitem.title: UK: Missing French girls found in London.
newsitem.headline: Missing French girls found in London.

text.p: Two French girls missing in London since Wednesday have been reunited with their families, police said on Saturday.
They were found by an office cleaner on Friday night in Cavendish Square, near London's Oxford street, where they went missing while shopping.
The teenagers told police they were too scared to approach anyone after they missed their coach home.
Police said Laetitia Ranson, 16, and Anjelique Wozniak, 15, from Grenay near Lille, were separated from the rest of their group while on a day trip to London.
The pair slept rough for two nights and ate food they had brought with them from France.
"They didn't know how to phone home from England or how to contact police in this country," said a spokeswoman.
"As they speak no English, although worried about their families, they said they were nervous about approaching anyone."
Police carrying photographs of the girls had been combing London's West End.
Their parents travelled to London to help find them and joined in police appeals for information.
Both families were expected to return to France on Saturday, police said.
